name: soft-door-box
task: Open the door, then, if possible, pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'Open the door' is an unconditional command, and the hard Existence(door_open) makes it happen. 'then, if possible, pick up the box' scopes the preference cue to the box pickup only, so Existence(target_picked_up) is correctly soft and forces nothing, while the 'then' order stays hard: Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) records the required order and is not redundant (the soft goal does not force door_open, and the order stays even though the environment also guarantees it). Since target_picked_up is only a soft goal, door_open is lone and its hard Existence is required, not redundant.

texts: Open the door at least once.
Pick up the target box at least once, if possible.
Pick up the target box only after the door has been opened.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2

REJECTING_STATES: u1

(u0, door_open&target_picked_up) -> u2
